'''J. Kegler TDIGWATT w/ bounty hunter/carbon freezing help''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[J. Kegler]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9358">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9358 TDIGWATT w/ bounty hunter/carbon freezing help], DeckTech (J. "Jedi2000" Kegler, 11 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9358/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9358/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018140115/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9358/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[J. Kegler]]
* '''Published:''' 11 August 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''TDIGWATT w/ bounty hunter/carbon freezing help''

== Original post ==

'''TDIGWATT w/ bounty hunter/carbon freezing help'''
* '''Author:''' J. "Jedi2000" Kegler
* '''Published:''' August 11, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' a this deal deck working on freezing,capturing and getting dark deal out to flip objective

=== Strategy ===

ok set up cloud city nad the bespin system, station mara w/ saber or epp vader at carbonite chamber for all too easy try to capture and freeze and put into prison w/bountys and bounty hunters and then get out dark deal and drain away
